question: Is Chesapeake or Virginia Beach cheaper to buy a home in?
answer: Based on closed sales from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, Virginia Beach had the lower median sold price: Chesapeake $420,000 versus Virginia Beach $405,000. Price per square foot was $219 in Chesapeake and $240 in Virginia Beach.
answer_short: Chesapeake $420,000 vs Virginia Beach $405,000 median sold price.
description: Chesapeake vs Virginia Beach home prices from REIN MLS closed sales: median price, price per square foot, days on market and negotiation room, compared by Chris Jenkins.

Beyond Price

Price is only one factor. Commute, flood zone and flood insurance cost, military air installation noise zones and association fees also change what a home really costs, and they vary by address. Our checklist covers how to check each one.
